description: This file defines an interface for reading profile information within the Conduit.Features.Profiles namespace. It declares a method for asynchronously reading a profile based on a username, supporting cancellation via a CancellationToken.

classes.name: IProfileReader
classes.description: An interface specifying a method to asynchronously read a user profile given a username and cancellation token.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a profile identified by username, supporting cancellation.
